steps.label: Enforce state
steps.sub: Resolved requires evidence, no skipping to Closed

code:
Test 1: move New -> Closed directly        expect: REFUSED
Test 2: move to Resolved, Resolution Code blank  expect: REFUSED
caption: If either test succeeds, the state model isn't actually enforced yet.

code:
Confirm with the business:
  Impact 1 = "affects the whole plant floor"
Then populate priority_lookup_rule so
Priority 1 (Critical) only = Impact 1 + Urgency 1
caption: Overrides stay available, but every one gets logged for review.

code:
Flow: Incident Created
  IF category == Network
  THEN assignment_group = Network Operations
  distribution: round robin across 6 agents
caption: Routing to the right group, then spreading work within it.

code:
IF priority == 1 AND affected_users > 50
THEN major_incident_state = Candidate
(a human still makes the Declared call)
caption: Priority alone would over-trigger a war room nobody needed.

subtitle: From fixing one incident to tracking its root cause.
